pageProps.title: gcc attribute: format, format_arg
pageProps.review: Explore in detail how to enable type-checking capabilities like printf and scanf in custom functions using GCC's format and format_arg attributes. We provide a guide to writing safe C code through practical real-world examples and internal workings.
pageProps.description: The format attribute specifies that a function takes printf, scanf, strftime or strfmon style arguments which should be type-checked against a format string.
